scope: Backend completeness upgrade preserving the existing ML/forecast/advisory pipeline
major_additions: PBKDF2 password hashing and password policy
password recovery token and OTP flows
0-100 deterministic risk scoring with factor contributions
defensive security telemetry and rate limiting
production_boundary: The bundled M1 artifact remains synthetic development data.
SQLite remains the pilot repository; use PostgreSQL for multi-instance production.
SMTP or an operator-controlled OTP webhook is required for real password-recovery delivery.
Approved departmental identity, monitoring, object storage and upstream data integrations remain deployment-specific.
